## Change

Describe the actor, decision, and record affected.

## Verification

- [ ] Backend tests pass.
- [ ] Frontend tests, typecheck, and build pass.
- [ ] Relevant workflow, DDEX, deployment, or release verifier passes.
- [ ] New protocol behavior has a regression fixture.

## Boundaries

- [ ] Public claims still match `docs/CLAIMS_AND_LIMITS.md`.
- [ ] Catalog metadata is not promoted to authority.
- [ ] Evidence review is not described as creating ownership.
- [ ] Migration, receipt compatibility, tenant isolation, privacy, and abuse impact are documented.
- [ ] No credential, private agreement, personal data, or confidential catalog evidence is included.
